Hi Jared — thanks for the attachments and the clear list. From procurement & security we need the following to complete vendor setup and route a PO: 

1) Signed DPA (we received BeaconPay_Signed_DPA.pdf — good).
2) Latest SOC 2 report or a secure portal link with an expiry date for access (we prefer a timeboxed link).
3) Subprocessor registry (spreadsheet is fine; we store on vendor record).
4) W-9/Company tax form (for US vendors) — this is required for PO creation.

Process notes / answers to your questions:
- Yes, a PO (PO_0004721 in our system) must be issued before we pay supplier invoices. We can fast-track PO issuance once the security checklist is satisfied.
- Attach the signed DPA and subprocessor list to the vendor record; procurement will cross-reference them when issuing the PO. If you prefer, you can also attach them to the DocuSign envelope or share via a secure drive link.

Next steps I propose:
- You send the SOC 2 access link (timeboxed) + W-9 by end of day tomorrow.
- Marissa (vendor ops) will confirm vendor record creation and the expected PO issuance SLA.

Marissa — can you confirm the PO SLA and any notes on the vendor tax form? Vivek / Marcus, if there are any security clarifications (subprocessor or encryption controls) please flag.

Appreciate it,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference

(415) 555-0133

Thanks Naomi / Jared — looping in the vendor onboarding queue. A few practical items from vendor ops: 

- PO SLA: Standard is 5 business days from receipt of complete vendor package (DPA, SOC 2 access, subproc list, W-9). If the SOC 2 link is timeboxed we can still proceed; please ensure it’s valid for at least 48 hours after submission.
- Tax form: We need a PDF W-9 (signed). For non-US entities we accept the equivalent tax residency docs — let us know.
- Subprocessor list: please include a column for processing location (region) and whether each subprocessor handles production data. That helps security triage.

Internal note: Vivek, Marcus — initial pass on subprocessor list indicates 2 cloud-hosting partners plus a payments gateway (likely fine), but please attest if any of the subprocessors are on our restricted list.

Jared — once the SOC 2 link and W-9 are in, I’ll create the vendor record and kick off PO_0004721 routing. I will attach the DPA and subprocessor file on creation and share the vendor portal link so you can verify the attachments.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Vendor Onboarding Lead | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
